title: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer to design, build, and evolve shared cloud platform services consumed by product and application teams. This role treats the cloud platform as a product, delivering reusable building blocks, paved roads, and a consistent developer experience aligned with CCoE standards. Responsibilities Build reusable platform capabilities, including shared services, standard compute patterns, and golden baselines, that enable safe, rapid workload onboarding Maintain and enhance centralized services such as logging, monitoring, secrets, identity, file transfers, and key management Co-create paved roads and golden paths in partnership with product teams, security, and operations Collaborate closely with Cloud DevOps/Automation engineers to codify platform interfaces in IaC and pipelines Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, resilience, and developer experience Serve as the voice of the customer to prioritize platform features and lifecycle investments Ensure platform capabilities align with security, compliance, and enterprise architecture guardrails Requirements 3+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience, with a product/platform mindset Deep knowledge of AWS compute, storage, networking, and managed services, including EKS, ECS, and Lambda Expertise in AWS managed services such as EC2 and RDS Strong background in architecting shared services for logging, monitoring, and secrets management Background in centralized integrations including Transfer Family, KMS, and IAM federation Familiarity with security-by-design practices, including IAM roles and SSO/OAuth integrations Understanding of SIEM feeds and policy-as-code Experience defining platform APIs/interfaces and collaborating with DevOps/IaC teams to automate adoption Customer-centric mindset with excellent stakeholder communication English proficiency at B2 level or higher We offer International projects with top brands Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers Healthcare benefits Employee financial programs Paid time off and sick leave Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses Global career opportunities Volunteer and community involvement opportunities EPAM Employee Groups Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn EPAM is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
